claim: Stage 2 — The Moving Staircase, and Why the Seam Is Free §: a voice dropped nine octaves at the wrap costs nothing perceptually — 'the eye sees the join the ear forgives'. The whole page is an auditory illusion; prose cannot make a reader fail to hear a seam.

pieces.section: Stage 1 — A Static Drone Is Already an Illusion
pieces.what: seven sines under a log-frequency Gaussian, toggled one by one; tests 'fusion into one pitch class' before anything moves

pieces.section: Stage 2 — The Moving Staircase, and Why the Seam Is Free
pieces.what: the staircase with the wrapping voice flashed red; tests the free seam by ear against eye
pieces.walks_up_from: the static drone, stepped one semitone

pieces.section: Stage 3 — The Glide, and Why the Stack Must Move as One
pieces.what: lockstep vs ±15% / ±40% drift vs Hz-slew, A/B with the cents error shown; tests 'one glide or the staircase breaks'

pieces.section: Stage 4 — The Timbre, and Where the Window Lives
pieces.what: filter tracking the voice vs tracking the note, and window on voice vs on sum; tests the brightness seam and the 6 Hz thump
pieces.walks_up_from: sawtooth voices with a fixed cutoff ratio
